title: Clean a Messy Spreadsheet: A Data Cleaning Playbook
description: Takes a deliberately dirty sales workbook with mixed date formats, duplicate rows and misspelt categories and cleans it step by step, logging every change so the result can be audited and the process rerun.

title: SQL Analytics Workbook for a Bike-Share Dataset
description: Answers twenty business questions about trips and stations in SQL, from simple counts to window functions, and builds a short report that pairs each query with its chart and a plain-language reading.

title: Exploratory Analysis of a Public Health Survey in R
description: Cleans a national health survey extract, weights responses and plots patterns by age group and region, with every chart labelled to avoid implying causes the data cannot support.

title: Dashboard of Municipal Budget Spending with Apache Superset
description: Loads city budget files into a database and builds drill-down dashboards by department and year, documenting the assumptions behind each measure so citizens can check the numbers.

title: Large Taxi Trip Dataset Processing with Apache Spark
description: Processes tens of millions of trip records with Spark, compares the same aggregations on one machine and on a small cluster, and reports where partitioning and caching change runtimes.

title: Analytics Engineering Project with dbt and Tests
description: Models raw order data into tested staging and mart tables with dbt, adds data quality tests for keys and accepted values and shows what breaks, and how it is caught, when the source changes.

title: Fast Dataframe Pipeline Comparison: Pandas, Polars and DuckDB
description: Implements one analysis three ways on a multi-gigabyte file, measures time and memory, and writes guidance on when each tool is the right choice for a student laptop. Includes a reproducible benchmark script.

title: A/B Test Power and Sample Size Planner
description: Lets a user enter a baseline rate and the smallest change worth detecting, computes the needed sample size and simulates repeated experiments to show how often wrong conclusions appear when tests are stopped early.

title: Carbon Footprint Calculator for Campus Travel
description: Estimates emissions from how students and staff travel to campus using published factors, shows which changes would save the most and states the uncertainty of each factor rather than a falsely exact total.

title: Household Energy Saving Recommender from Smart Meter Data
description: Analyses half-hourly consumption to find standby loads and peak-time habits, estimates savings for each suggested change and ranks suggestions by effort and payback. Includes a plain-language summary page for householders.

title: Reproducible Research Report with Quarto and Containers
description: Packages an analysis as a Quarto document with pinned dependencies in a container so a reader can regenerate every figure with one command, and documents what was needed to make it reproduce.

title: Bias Audit of a Public Benchmark Dataset
description: Examines who is and is not represented in a popular open dataset, measures performance gaps of a simple model across groups and writes a datasheet documenting limits and recommended uses.

title: Time Series Forecasting Competition Harness
description: Builds an evaluation harness that scores forecasting methods under rolling origins with identical data access, preventing leakage by design and producing a leaderboard with confidence intervals.

title: Hospital Waiting Time Analysis with Queueing Theory
description: Fits arrival and service patterns for an emergency department from open data, compares a queueing model with a discrete-event simulation and tests staffing changes against both.

title: Geospatial Accessibility Analysis of Public Services
description: Computes travel-time catchments to clinics and schools from road networks, finds neighbourhoods with poor access and tests how siting one new facility changes coverage. Includes a map layer for each scenario.
